notes.title: Demo Version Closure Notice
notes.notes: [p]Dear players,[/p][p][/p][p]First of all, we’d like to thank everyone who has played, tested, and supported the Dark Fairy Tale: Dreamland Survivors demo so far![/p][p]Your valuable feedback has helped us improve the game tremendously.[/p][p][/p][p]To ensure that all players experience the game closer to its true, updated version, we’ve decided to take the demo offline for now.[/p][p]The current demo differs significantly from the actual game in gameplay, balance, visuals, and features, and no longer represents what we want new players to see.[/p][p]We don’t want this version to cause confusion or mislead new players.[/p][p][/p][p]We’re continuing to refine the game, add more content, and polish the experience. Please stay tuned for future updates — and feel free to join our community and share your thoughts with us anytime![/p][p]Thank you so much for your support and understanding![/p][p][/p][p]— BINGOBELL Team[/p]

notes.title: V1.0.4.1240 Update — REBORN
notes.notes: [h3][b]🧩 Reset & Optimization[/b][/h3][p]1. Dream Realm & Level-Up Rewards[/p][list][*][p]The previous system of obtaining Dream Eggs upon leveling up has been removed. Now, when leveling up, you can directly choose a reward attribute. 54 new upgrade attributes have been added.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/346a16f5a483f5bbcb6afbe0a55825a9df1bc353.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]Normal Dream Realms now have selectable difficulty levels. Clearing higher difficulties will grant you more Dream Crystals and Nightmare Sigils.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/08d9eb2532250077b339f28a3392505d75f1f500.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The amount of Nightmare Sigils gained from consuming Dream Eggs has been reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]When progressing to the next Dream Realm floor, you will automatically receive a certain number of Nightmare Sigils.[/p][/*][/list][p]2. Talent Adjustments[/p][list][*][p]There is no longer a limit to the number of Talents you can own — all Talents can now be enhanced simultaneously. Some high-tier Talents will unlock automatically after spending a certain number of Nightmare Sigils.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45277365/309476ca798478812b17f8b49dfe2dbc329fadc4.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]The enhancement cost and max level of Talents have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]Faction Talents no longer require Nightmare Sigils to enhance. They now consume Dream Crystals instead. Dream Crystals can be obtained after clearing 15 floors in the Deep Dive Dream Realm.[/p][/*][*][p]After the update, your Faction Talent levels will be kept. Regular Talent levels will be reset, and the spent Nightmare Sigils will be refunded.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]⚖️ Adjustments[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Optimized the level-up effects and added new visual effects.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a dodge count indicator halo under the protagonist’s feet.[/p][/*][*][p]The character’s status panel now displays new stats: main weapon attack speed, HP regeneration, and damage immunity chance (capped at 70%).[/p][/*][*][p]Added a shortcut tip for the backpack at the bottom(Q) of the combat interface.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the behavior logic of Enraged Black Swan and Lazy Crystal Shoes, so their projectiles are always thrown at a set distance from the protagonist.[/p][/*][*][p]Added two new Talents: Periodic Regeneration and Survivor’s Secret, which boost HP regeneration and damage immunity chance respectively.[/p][/*][*][p]In Endless Mode, the Devil’s Bargain now appears every 5 minutes, and the chance for buffs to appear has been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance adjustment: the max level cap for the protagonist and tags has been raised to 400.[/p][/*][*][p]Projectiles fired by the protagonist now use a single fixed style instead of multiple random ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased projectile flight speed by 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]Hoarder Dream Egg: The 30% pickup radius bonus now converts into base attack power instead — changed from 30% to 20%.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage Dream Egg: When taking damage, you gain a shield equal to 10% of max HP for 20 seconds — adjusted to 5 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Simplified the tutorial for new players.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]⚙️ Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the main weapon’s attack speed was not taking effect.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a problem where absorbing a large amount of XP and coins would cause stuttering.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Sun Tarot Card devour effect caused severe lag.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the monster damage formula to fix an issue where the protagonist couldn’t deal damage to monsters properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted protagonist and monster stats to fix an issue where attributes did not increase after level 100.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the flip progress in Tarot Dream and Random Tarot Dream did not sync properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the instant-kill effect did not have its trigger chance halved on special monsters.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]📬 Contact us — we look forward to your feedback and suggestions!👉[url="https://discord.com/invite/WNy9nSh3vP"]Discord[/url][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]To Player[/b][/h3][p]If this update surprised you or got you curious about what’s coming next,[/p][p]don’t forget to drop us a review and share your feedback on Steam![/p][p]Your support keeps us going — next stop, we keep pushing forward together![/p][p]Thank you[/p][p][/p][h3]👉Steam page [/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288300/Dark_Fairy_Tale_Dreamland_Survivors/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – V1.0.4.1106
notes.notes: [h3]🧩 [b]\[New][/b][/h3][p]In Endless Dream Mode, a brand-new NPC — the Demon Chest — will now appear every 3 minutes.[/p][p]💀 Deal with the Devil:[/p][p]When you open the Demon Chest, you must pay a certain amount of silver coins for each card you reveal. We'll do our best to keep improving the game and maintain open, positive communication with all of you.[/h3][h3]👉Steam page [/h3][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288300/Dark_Fairy_Tale_Dreamland_Survivors/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288300/Dark_Fairy_Tale_Dreamland_Survivors/[/url][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes – V1.0.4.955
notes.notes:
[h3]V1.0.4.955[/h3][h3]⚙️ \[New Features][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Venom Splash[/b] was triggered by all damage sources instead of intended ones.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the [b]player became immobile after pressing TAB[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the [b]Matchbox item could fall outside the map boundaries[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚖️ \[Adjustments][/h3][list][*][p][b]Normal Mode[/b]: Total number of stages reduced from 25 to 15.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fang Build – Bleed Effect[/b]: Status damage multiplier reduced from ×2 to ×1.5.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Items – Shield Dream Egg & Sage’s Shield[/b]: Trigger condition changed from “at the start of each stage” to “every 60 seconds.”[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item – Molten Heart[/b]: Burn damage no longer always crits; now grants [b]+30% critical chance[/b] on burn damage and can [b]stack[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Player Character[/b]: Damage interval reduced from [b]0.6s to 0.3s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Damage Calculation Adjusted[/b]: Improved the damage formula to enhance the effect of defense and reduce late-game one-shot scenarios.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Main Weapon Balancing[/b]: Adjusted attack intervals between each primary weapon.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Item – Revival Dream Egg[/b]: Added visual effects when reviving.[/p][/*][*][p][b]SFX Improvements[/b]: Added sound effects for certain monsters.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI Optimization[/b]: Improved overall user interface clarity and layout.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🧩 [b]\[New][/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]15 new Steam achievements[/b] have been added![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]📬 Contact us — we look forward to your feedback and suggestions!👉[url="https://discord.com/invite/WNy9nSh3vP"]Discord[/url][/h2][h3] Your feedback and support mean the world to us. We'll do our best to keep improving the game and maintain open, positive communication with all of you.


👉Steam page

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3288300/Dark_Fairy_Tale_Dreamland_Survivors/"][/dynamiclink][/h3]

notes.title: Patch V1.0.2.451 Update: Tarot Power Upgrades & Brand-New UI Overhaul
notes.notes:
⚙️ [New Features]
• Added out-of-run Tarot ability system — start with a permanent Tarot devour effect
• Updated game UI interface
• Added new special enemies: Vengeful Ugly Duckling and Lazy Crystal Shoe
•🌍 Localization Support
New languages are now available and can be changed in the game settings:
[list]
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Brazilian Portuguese
[*] Italian
[*] Turkish
[*] Russian
[/list]

⚖️ [Adjustments]
• Improved game flow — now players can continuously progress up to layer 25
• Enhanced visual and artistic effects in-game
